title: English Fell From 75% To Under Half The Web
hook: English once filled 75% of the web, then lost its majority.
closing: Searching only in English leaves a huge share of the internet invisible to you.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: English filled 75% of web pages, before global access pushed its share below half.
Arabic content grew 2,501%, showing newer internet users built online worlds beyond English.
English still covers 55% of websites, but nearly half the web now speaks differently.
